name: Drawing suite exercises Pen, Dither Brush, Flood Fill, Color Replace, and Eyedropper
description: Verify drawing a solid circle, coloring it with Flood Fill, applying ordered Bayer dithering across its surface, replacing target colors with Color Replace, and sampling colors using Eyedropper.

planSteps.description: Verify the pixel art canvas workspace is visible in the center viewport
Click the Ellipse tool button in the left toolbar (or press O)
Click on the center drawing canvas to stamp a circular shape
Click the Flood Fill tool button in the left toolbar (or press G)
Click on the canvas to fill the shape with color
Verify artwork is visibly rendered on the canvas
Click the Dither Brush tool button in the left toolbar (or press D)
Click on the canvas to paint with the dither brush
Click the Color Replace tool button in the left toolbar (press R on keyboard)
Click on the colored circle to execute an instant color replacement across all matching pixels
Click the Eyedropper tool button in the left toolbar (press I on keyboard)
Click on any colored pixel on the canvas to pick its color
Verify the primary color swatch in the left toolbar updates to match the sampled color without producing drawing artifacts
